messages:
maria: Heads up — planning X + LinkedIn assets for the April webinar ("Serving inference economics"). Need: thread copy, 1 LinkedIn post, hero image, 15s promo clip, and the routing/UTM scheme. Aim: two X posts (announcement + reminder) and a LinkedIn thread. Can we lock by EOD Mon?
josh: Draft copy in Google doc: https://docs.google.com/example — i'll paste quick hooks below. Will need edits for thread cadence.
kevin: Good. Also want to wire lead routing to SDR so high-intent regs go to our team immediately. Sam can you confirm HubSpot list + owner rotation?
sam (SDR): Yep — propose HubSpot list = webinar_serving_econ. Route to team queue 'SDR - Growth' with round-robin. Also need UTM + landing url variants. Example UTM: `?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_econ_v1`
priya: I’ll create the form with hidden fields for source/campaign and tags. Send final landing URL and decide primary CTA (Register / Watch Live). Also confirm whether we push registrants to nurture flow immediately.
josh: Quick copy snippets for review (short + thread-friendly):
- X post A: "Webinar Apr 8: Cut inference costs without sacrificing quality. Join our engineers to see how -> https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-economics #mlops"
- X post B (reminder): "1 day to go — optimizing serving beats model size. Last spots: https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-economics"
- LinkedIn thread opener: "Serving LLMs at scale is more ops than research. We ran experiments across 3 workloads — results you can use. Thread 👇"
maria: Love these. Can we A/B test the hook on X? Option A: 'Cut inference cost by 3x' Option B: 'Same model, half the price' — pick two audiences.
kevin: A/B sounds good. Target audiences: A = startups/infra leads, B = enterprise infra/platform. We'll push different creatives to each.
priya: For tracking, I want separate UTMs per audience: `utm_campaign=serving_econ_startup` and `..._enterprise`. Also need a paid ad variant if we repurpose.
sam (SDR): For follow-ups — i'll draft two quick templates:
- After register (auto): "Thanks for registering! Can we schedule a 20-min chat to discuss your infra goals?"
- High-engagement (watched + asked Q): "Saw you joined and asked about latency — can we set 15 min to review your traces?"
josh: Asset ask: need hero PNG (1200x628), slide title image, and a 15s MP4 clip (16:9, mp4, <10MB). Who can make the clip?
maria: @josh can prod design but if design is blocked i can splice a clip from the slides. @priya can you confirm creative deadline? Need everything by Tue noon for scheduling.
priya: Confirmed — i'll set asset deadline Tue 12:00 PST. Also will wire a Zap to create a HubSpot contact + deal on registration and tag 'webinar_serving_econ'.
buffer-bot: Draft saved to Buffer queue: April 7 09:00 PST (pending approval).
maria: Final approvals: @josh finish copy by Mon 3pm PST, @kevin final audience targeting by Mon 5pm, @priya set up HubSpot + UTM by Tue 9am, @sam confirm SDR templates by Tue 10am. Ping this thread when done :pray:
buffer-bot: Reminder set — embargo window ends Apr 6 23:59 PST. Scheduled posts will remain drafts until release window opens.
maria: Thanks team — if we can get the landing URL and final CTAs today i'll approve the copy and schedule the first announcement.
